function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

message.content: Shashi Tej Reddy (born 1975) is an Indian entrepreneur, philanthropist, and former politician known for his work in technology and social impact. He co‑founded several tech startups in Bangalore, including a cloud‑based logistics platform that was acquired by a Fortune 500 company in 2018. After leaving the private sector, he served as a member of the Karnataka Legislative Assembly from 2019 to 2023, where he focused on education reform and digital infrastructure. In 2024 he launched the Shashi Tej Foundation, a nonprofit dedicated to improving STEM education for underprivileged youth across India.
